tasks.CalculateProbability: Calculate the probability that a randomly selected driver has a blue car and red hair based on the given data.

Questions.content: What is the total number of drivers recorded in the study, and how does it affect the calculation of the probability?

Answers.content:
The total number of drivers recorded in the study can be found by summing up all the entries in the table. From the given data:

| Red hair | Blonde hair |
|----------|-------------|
| 7 (Red car) | 3 (Red car) |
| 3 (Blue car) | 6 (Blue car) |

The total number of drivers is \(7 + 3 + 3 + 6 = 19\).

This total affects the calculation of the probability because the probability that a randomly selected driver has a blue car and red hair is given by the number of drivers with both characteristics divided by the total number of drivers. In this case, there are 3 drivers who have a blue car and red hair.

So, the probability \(P\) can be calculated as:

\[ P = \frac{\text{Number of drivers with a blue car and red hair}}{\text{Total number of drivers}} = \frac{3}{19} \]

This fraction is already in its simplest form.
